description: A polyphonic saturator shaped after a valve stage, driving the signal into a soft curve and scaling the result back

params.text: Sets how hard the signal is driven into the curve, 1 to 10; the output is scaled back as the drive rises, so a 5V peak stays near 5V and the waveform rounds off instead of growing louder

outputs.text: The saturated signal, carrying as many channels as the input
